notes: No Finnish food-truck / ruokarekka ordering tool found: six searches returned only Jotform, MenuTiger, comparison/listing sites and Wolt (excluded). Food4you is the only Finland-specific restaurant tool confirmed (no food-truck wording; set-up 490 € or 790 € + alv, recorded as 490 on each plan). Food4you price quotes are the short plan figures ("39€ / kk"); the page reader gave them as separate fragments, so the checker should confirm their exact spacing. Creavo Order is table ordering only (not_relevant). SumUp counted as pos via its Finnish online store with pickup (0 €/kk, 1,49 %), which is a generic web shop with no food wording. Zettle Finland shows no online ordering. "Restis" came up in a search summary but restis.fi does not resolve; GastroSprint appeared only on a comparison site and was not checked (its own site and Finnish presence unknown).
